method: Fresh source-only review of current release.sh, ship.sh, unpacked helper, unit guard, and local bare-origin fixture. No tests, builds, UI, Git mutations, or release commands executed.

A_original_findings_and_requirements.verdict: PASS in source, pending root runtime verification

original_findings.unvalidated_ship_push: ADDRESSED: ship.sh execs release.sh; generation, checks, Store/local ZIP construction and package checks precede git push --atomic (release.sh:385-407).
original_findings.conflict_omission: ADDRESSED: merge-tree conflict stops before validation/publication and preserves both refs (release.sh:251-263).
original_findings.separate_main_tag_push: ADDRESSED: one atomic main/tag push; rejection refetches and revalidates a new candidate (release.sh:406-421).
original_findings.dirty_exclusion_notice: ADDRESSED: excluded checkout paths print and log before each push attempt (release.sh:391-405).
original_findings.snapshot_setup_failure: ADDRESSED: export/setup and prepare failures return nonzero and stop before publication (release.sh:166-190, 393-394).
original_findings.live_lock_theft: ADDRESSED: occupied lock fails closed, including missing/unknown PID; owner lock is never reclaimed on elapsed time (release.sh:194-215).
original_findings.unpacked_cleanup_after_receipt: ADDRESSED: receipt is the commit point; subsequent backup cleanup warns and retains the path without signaling rollback (scripts/sync-unpacked-release.mjs:74-82, 165-168, 200-213).
original_findings.failed_zip_restore_backup_loss: ADDRESSED: restore checks each move/delete, reports incomplete recovery and retains staging outside EXIT cleanup (release.sh:429-457, 483-485).

A_original_findings_and_requirements.other_requirements: --no-push maps to dry-run before lock/build/push (release.sh:121-123, 228-240); failed check/build leaves remote refs untouched; shell fixture uses a temp local bare origin and real helper CLI fault guard uses only mkdtemp paths.
A_original_findings_and_requirements.material_limit: Remote publication precedes local ZIP/unpacked installation by design; a local installation failure leaves the remote release published and reports that state. Atomicity is per remote refs and recoverable local artifacts, not one transaction across GitHub and the filesystem.

B_quality_and_runtime.verdict: No new blocking source defect found within requested scope; runtime verification pending root.
B_quality_and_runtime.evidence: The recovery guard executes the actual helper CLI in temporary directories and injects filesystem failures at cleanup, receipt commit, and backup restore; it asserts installed bundle versions, retained backups, and receipt contents. The shell guard constructs a throwaway bare origin and checkout, stubs build commands, and injects lock/race/ZIP failures.
limitations: This reviewer did not execute node --test, the shell fixture, pnpm tests, a real build, UI exercise, or release.
The shell fixture's stubbed pnpm commands prove gate ordering and refusal, not the actual compiler/build/package tools; root's admitted checks and build are still required.

Post-publication stale ZIP deletion at release.sh:493-494 has no checked outcome; a deletion error could leave an old upload ZIP without a finding. This is a nonblocking cleanup/reporting gap, distinct from validated current ZIP and receipt integrity.
